title: nobadeffects
description: A lightweight client-side mod that removes annoying visual status effects.
body:
# No Bad Effects

No Bad Effects removes Minecraft's most annoying visual status effects and screen overlays, letting you enjoy a cleaner and more comfortable experience without changing gameplay.

Whether you dislike nausea distortion, darkness pulses, blindness fog, or powder snow visibility reduction, No Bad Effects gives you full control with simple per-effect toggles.

✨ Features

🌀 Remove Nausea distortion — disables the screen warping effect caused by Nausea and Nether Portals

⬛ Remove Darkness — disables the Darkness effect and Warden-induced visual dimming

👁️ Remove Blindness fog — restores visibility while affected by Blindness

❄️ Remove Powder Snow fog — removes the visibility-reducing fog inside Powder Snow

⚙️ Individual toggles — enable or disable each effect separately

🪶 Lightweight & client-side — no gameplay changes, no unnecessary overhead

💾 Automatically saved — your preferences persist between sessions

🎛️ Configuration

Open the configuration screen through Mod Menu and toggle the effects you want to disable.

Changes are applied instantly and saved automatically.

📦 Requirements

* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API
* Mod Menu (optional, recommended)

🔒 Client-Side Only

No Bad Effects only modifies visual rendering on your client and does not affect gameplay mechanics.

Safe to use on multiplayer servers.;

 Why?

Many players find certain visual effects distracting, uncomfortable, or simply unnecessary. No Bad Effects allows you to remove those effects while preserving the vanilla gameplay experience.
